title: Settings
subtitle: Organization, billing, scanning, sounds, notifications and integrations

appearance.heading: Appearance
appearance.scannerLayoutHorizontalDescription: Scanner in sidebar, cards on the right
appearance.scannerLayoutVerticalDescription: Scanner on top, card grid below

pricing.heading: Pricing
pricing.description: Choose which marketplace prices your organization's cards, collection values and Discord posts use. Card Kingdom only prices Magic: The Gathering cards.

sessionWrapped.heading: Session Wrapped
sessionWrapped.description: Show a Wrapped-style recap of stat highlights before the export summary.

ocr.heading: Text recognition (OCR)
ocr.description: When a scan isn't a confident match, read the card's name and set line to find it. Applies to every scanner in this organization, for games with text regions set up.

draft.saveFailed: Couldn't save your settings. Try again.

correctionAutoClose.heading: Card correction prompt
correctionAutoClose.promptToggleLabel: Ask me to move corrected cards
correctionAutoClose.promptToggleDescription: Turn this off if you leave corrected cards where they were sorted. The card keeps its current bin and no prompt is shown.
correctionAutoClose.description: After you correct or identify a card, a prompt shows which bin it's in and which bin it belongs in. Auto-close accepts that you moved the card once the time runs out, so you don't have to click.
correctionAutoClose.toggleLabel: Auto-close and mark the card as moved

deployPause.heading: Updates
deployPause.description: When Mault is being updated, any sorter that's scanning is paused and a prompt explains why, so no cards are lost if a save fails mid-update. You can resume straight away from the prompt.
